subject: BYO/KMS onboarding — audit logs & retention questions
messages:
From: Katie Marshall <katie@clearhealth.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BYO/KMS onboarding — audit logs & retention questions

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — ClearHealth is excited about the low-latency routing and the Dedicated options. Procurement asked me to collect a few technical/compliance items so we can get an internal green-light for a BYO/KMS pilot: 

1) Audit logs: what level of detail is available for tokenized requests (request id, model variant, region, latency) and can we get continuous exports to our SIEM?
2) Retention windows: we need a clear mapping of what data is kept in short-term caches (ephemeral) vs. longer audit stores and what controls we expose for customers to shorten retention.
3) Key ownership: can Redwood support a customer-managed KMS in our Azure tenant? If not, what are the recommended handover steps and proof points for key custody?
4) SSO / provisioning: we want an estimate for SAML provisioning timeline and whether user-level audit events map to our SCIM identities.

I've attached our (slimmed) security questionnaire and a high-level procurement timeline. Can we set a short triage call next week? Prefer mornings PT.

Thanks,
Katie Marshall
Director, IT Security | ClearHealth
Attachments: clearhealth_security_questionnaire_v2.pdf, procurement_timeline.xlsx
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Marshall <katie@clearhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BYO/KMS onboarding — audit logs & retention questions

Hi Katie — really appreciate the detail. Looping in Product (Marissa), Security (Jonas) and Infra (Karthik) to triage. 

Short answers up front:
- Audit exports: yes — we support near-real-time streaming to customer SIEMs (Kafka/HTTP). We'll document field-level schema and a sample Kibana mapping.
- Retention: default platform audit retention is 90 days for request metadata; ephemeral KV cache is transient per-session unless configured for longer short-term caching. We can propose a short-term retention carveout for pilot customers.
- BYOK: Dedicated supports customer KMS (Azure/AWS GCP) via a service account and key-wrapping; Private deployments can integrate with your tenant. We'll detail the key rotation handoff model.
- SSO/SCIM: SAML + SCIM provisioning is supported; user audit events include SCIM user id when provisioned.

Proposed next step: 30-min triage call to align on which artifacts ClearHealth needs for procurement (evidence pack vs. live demo + MOP). I made a Calendly link — can you pick a slot? I'll prepare a short MOP mapping and a mutual action plan and send before the call.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_clh-4872.docx (stub)
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 13:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BYO/KMS onboarding — audit logs & retention questions

Aditya / team — quick security triage notes (we should capture these as discrete asks in the MAP):

1) Audit schema: we will need to provide a field-level mapping that includes request_id, account_id, model_id, model_variant, compute_region, token_counts (input/output), and a signed ingestion timestamp. Also confirm whether we can add a trace id to link into CH's internal transaction logs.
2) SIEM export modes: support for push vs pull (we have a Kafka push connector and an HTTP delivery mode). For Kafka we need broker/network access details for ClearHealth and a retained topic policy (we recommend 30 days TTL on the customer side unless they request otherwise).
3) Key custody proof: prepare an architecture diagram showing KMS in ClearHealth tenant, the key-wrapping flow, and the HSM-backed envelope key usage. Add a short note on rotation ceremony and who performs emergency revocation.
4) Ephemeral caches & SLOs: define maximum potential TTL and a knob to forcibly flush cache for a customer. Product should decide acceptable default and whether we need an exception for pilot.

Karthik — can you draft the KMS handoff diagram and the minimum network requirements? Marissa — need your priority decision on whether short-term retention can be set to 7 days for the pilot (security wants 30-day default but will accept a carveout if product signs off). Naomi, please flag any legal gotchas for key custody language.

I'll compile answers into a 1-pager we can hand to ClearHealth before the call.

- Jonas
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BYO/KMS onboarding — audit logs & retention questions

Thanks — agreeing on who owns each deliverable will keep this moving. Proposed split and timeline (pilot target: May start):

- Product (Marissa): decide pilot retention carveout (yes -> 7 days) and produce a short config guide for ephemeral cache toggles. ETA: 2028-04-20.
- Infra (Karthik): KMS handoff diagram + network access checklist and sample terraform for service account. ETA: 2028-04-18.
- Security (Jonas): 1-pager evidence pack and rotation/incident playbook. ETA: 2028-04-18.
- Legal (Naomi): propose minimal contract language for key custody and emergency revocation. ETA: 2028-04-19.
- Sales (Aditya): finalize MAP and confirm ClearHealth scope + schedule triage call. ETA: 2028-04-17.

Is everyone OK with those ETAs? If so I'll slot a 30-min call for 2028-04-18 morning PT and share an agenda. Also, product decision note: setting a 7-day pilot retention for metadata only (not full request payloads) keeps us conservative while enabling their QA.

Marissa
Director, Product | Redwood Inference
From: Katie Marshall <katie@clearhealth.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Coleman <ben.coleman@clearhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearhealth.com>

Subject: Re: BYO/KMS onboarding — audit logs & retention questions

Aditya / team — thanks for the quick responses and the proposed splits. Ben and I confirmed we can be flexible on a metadata-only 7-day pilot retention. We booked the 2028-04-18 09:30 slot via your Calendly and attached the completed questionnaire. Please send the MAP and the KMS diagram before the call.

See you —
Katie
